name: walkthrough-video-duration
description: PARITY-VIDEO tail: the Record-walkthrough duration prompt + MP4/WebM format pick. Saves two views, opens the themed duration prompt via promptAndRecordViewTour, screenshots it (desktop + mobile), then resolves it and asserts the tour starts with the chosen pace + recording is armed. Also logs pickRecordingFormat over the real headless MediaRecorder.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: log-format
steps.eval: import('/src/scene/recordingFormat.ts').then(m => { const f = m.pickRecordingFormat(t => typeof MediaRecorder !== 'undefined' && MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(t)); console.log('RECFMT', JSON.stringify(f), 'mp4Supported=', typeof MediaRecorder !== 'undefined' && MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('video/mp4;codecs=avc1.640028')) })

steps.name: save-two-views
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); st.saveCurrentView('A'); st.requestTopView?.(); st.saveCurrentView('B'); })()

steps.name: verify-two-views
steps.failMessage: expected at least two saved views

steps.failMessage: duration prompt modal did not open

steps.failMessage: resolving the duration prompt did not start the saved-views tour
